name: poiseuille_channel
description: axmp.mesh(channel) (the design note's 4.1 channel, L = 4H): the parabolic inflow 6 U y (H - y) / H^2 on inlet, do_nothing on outlet, no-slip on walls; with form laplacian plane Poiseuille flow is exact in P2/P1 (asserted); with form stress the outlet disturbance is not an exactness test: it is asserted to exceed 1e-3 U_mean within H of the outlet and to fall by at least 100 from x < L - H to x < L - 2H; its values are recorded
mesh: the mesher's unstructured mesh of the document (gmsh, bounded planar mode, algorithm and options of axmp-mesher), mesh.size = H/16, geometry order 2 (the default: straight edges, with nodes); one process

end_modes.symmetric: velocity even about the centreline: sin 2k - 2k = 0, 2k = 7.4977 + 2.7687i, a factor exp(-7.50) = 5.5e-4 per channel height; excited by the stress form's outlet condition on every mesh; dominates between L - H and L - 2H
end_modes.antisymmetric: sin 2k + 2k = 0, 2k = 4.2124 + 2.2507i, a factor exp(-4.21) = 1.5e-2 per channel height; not excited by the continuous problem, excited at a small amplitude on an unstructured mesh; can dominate beyond about 2.5H, so the ratio between L - 2H and L - 3H is recorded only (every end mode gives at least exp(4.21) = 67 there)

u.what: max |u - u_P| / (1.5 U) at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element, form laplacian

p.what: max |p - p_P| / (12 nu U L / H^2) at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element, form laplacian

unrecorded_platforms: the lr7 nodes of feature rocky8 (n0150 to n0153), a second processor model of the lr7 partition
any other partition the gate is pointed at

document.name: channel
document.description: 2D water channel, Re = rho U_mean H / mu = 100, parabolic inflow, pressure outlet
